result:
I've written the review report with a verdict of `fix`: the Sessions page misses the owner's "first row in the top ~25%" target and has three smaller layout problems. I made no code edits.

- **First row too low:** at 1200 the first row sits about 41% down the page (y≈370 of 900), well past the ~25% target. At 1920 it is about 36% down.
- **Status rail too tall:** it takes two lines at 1200 and six at 400, and the "1 open task" and "show 30 more days" controls are still plain buttons, not small chips.
- **No day level:** the breadcrumb stops at "2026 / October", so the `/2026/10/13/` route can't be reached from it.
- **Clipped tag at 1920:** the MASTERMIND tag in the Role column is cut off under the SERVEX tag on the first row.

I couldn't check the "measure first" and before/after asks. This review folder has no before screenshot or numbers. The shots folder for the Sessions page also has no `layout.json`, so I judged layout from the screenshots alone.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/sessions-page-layout/review/report.md`.
